info.description:
# Morrow API

REST API for a shared personal calendar. Users can create calendars, invite other users to share them, and manage members and appointments.

## Base URL

All requests use `{{base_url}}` (set in the `Morrow local` environment).

## Authentication

Authentication uses Laravel Passport. Both endpoints return a JSON object with `user` and `token`. Register or log in to get an access token, then send it in every protected request:

`` Authorization: Bearer `YOUR_TOKEN` ``

## Conventions

- Send `Accept: application/json` and `Content-Type: application/json` in every request.
    
- Common status codes: `200` OK, `201` Created, `401` Unauthenticated, `403` Forbidden, `404` Not found, `409` Conflict, `422` Validation error.
    

## Status

Documented so far: `POST /api/register`, `POST /api/login`, `GET /api/users`.

request.description:
Updates a user. Admins can update any user. A normal user can only update their own data. Send only the fields you want to change.

**Authentication**

Requires a Bearer token (`Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN`).

**URL parameters**

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| id | The id of the user |

**Body (JSON)**

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name | string | no | max 255 characters |
| email | string | no | valid email format, must be unique (the user's own email is allowed) |
| password | string | no | minimum 8 characters |

**Responses**

\-`200`: user updated. Returns `user`.  
\-`401`: missing or invalid token.  
\-`403`: a normal user tried to update another user.  
\-`404`: the user does not exist.  
\-`422`: validation error (invalid email, email already taken or password too short).

request.description:
Creates a new user. Only available to admins. The new user gets the `user` role.

**Authentication**

Requires a Bearer token of an admin (`Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN`).

**Body (JSON)**

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name | string | yes | max 255 characters |
| email | string | yes | valid email format, must be unique |
| password | string | yes | minimum 8 characters |

**Responses**

- `201`: user created. Returns `user`.
    
- `401`: missing or invalid token.
    
- `403`: the authenticated user is not an admin.
    
- `422`: validation error (missing fields, invalid email, email already taken or password too short).

request.description:
Registers a new user and returns an access token.

**Body (JSON)**

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name | string | yes | max 255 characters |
| email | string | yes | valid email format, must be unique |
| password | string | yes | minimum 8 characters |

**Responses**

- `201`: user created. Returns `user` and `token`.
    
- `422`: validation error (missing fields, invalid email, email already taken or password too short).

Logs in an existing user and returns an access token.

**Body (JSON)**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| email | string | yes |
| password | string | yes |

**Responses**

- `200`: returns `user` and `token`.

- `422`: validation error (missing or malformed fields).
